description: Check whether a preview has been claimed into a GearHost account, and how long is left to claim it (the site is auto-removed at expiry unless claimed). Pass token, or name+project_key. Read-only. Returns structuredContent { status, url, claimed, claimable, expiring_soon, seconds_left, time_left, claim_url, owner }. claim_url is the page where the user can keep the site.

name.description: The site name (with project_key) instead of a token.

project_key.description: The project_key (with name) instead of a token.

name: get_claim_status

claimable.description: True if still within the claim window and not yet claimed.

expiring_soon.description: True within ~6h of expiry — prompt the user to claim now.

title: Get claim status
